timeline.title: Measure the curve before launch
timeline.narration: A smoother opening price can still give early buyers more tokens. Measure both before launch. This is a local validator, synthetic Xerox tokens, and a test signer.

timeline.title: One benefit. One cost. Same starting conditions.
timeline.narration: Same supply, opening price, reserve threshold, and fees. The long curve lowers the first price jump from three hundred eleven to two hundred thirty nine percent. But early buyers receive two point five three percentage points more of total buy output. Choose with both results visible.

timeline.title: Selling changes the next trade
timeline.narration: Now selling pressure. The opening buyer sells half, then retail buyers enter. Each trade updates reserves, fees, and inventory. Compare how much buying restores the pre sale price. Neither curve graduates here.

timeline.title: Export the evidence. Keep the exact configuration.
timeline.narration: Export the integer ledger and visual summary. Select the long curve. The transaction builder receives that exact configuration, also preserved in the share link.

timeline.title: Review the cost. Handle a declined approval.
timeline.narration: Check the cost before signing. This long curve needs two transactions. The configuration succeeds; we deliberately decline token creation.

timeline.title: Reload. Reuse the paid configuration. Finish launch.
timeline.narration: Reload the page. The saved transaction reference finds the paid configuration. Check the remaining cost without signing. Token creation uses a new mint address, shown before approval. Finish once, reusing the original curve. The recording checks it against the selected scenario configuration.

timeline.title: Quote, buy, then read the balance
timeline.narration: Read wallet balances. Quote a small buy, review minimum output, then sign. The refreshed token accounts show more base tokens and less quote.

timeline.title: Sell half. Check the actual change.
timeline.narration: Use half my token balance fills the exact amount. Review minimum output and sell. Base tokens decrease; the quote balance increases.

timeline.title: Cross the threshold and migrate
timeline.narration: A further buy reaches graduation with a partial fill. Review migration cost, then create the DAMM version two pool. Read both destination vault balances.

timeline.title: Predictions checked against actual execution
timeline.narration: Fifty six swaps across eight local pools checked both curves, SOL and Xerox, and fixed and declining fees. Predicted raw prices, reserves, fees, inventory, and quote transfers matched execution. Data and hashes are in the repository.

timeline.title: Measure. Choose. Launch. Verify.
timeline.narration: Scenarios expose trade offs, not forecasts. External quote liquidity and stock price changes are not modeled. Real Phantom execution, mainnet transactions, and builder trials remain open. Try the product and inspect the evidence.

launchRecovery.method: page reload after declined second approval

editing: Sequential normal-speed scene cuts; narration and captions added. Local environment banner persists.
